Veterans Benefits: Georgia provides age- and income-conditional military-retirement income exclusions, a disabled-veteran homestead exemption, employment preference, education and tuition assistance, free veteran driver's licenses, vehicle tags, veterans nursing homes, and hunting and fishing privileges.

Description: Columbus is a consolidated city-county on the Chattahoochee River adjacent to Fort Moore and Pratt & Whitney's Columbus Engine Center and Forge. It has local VA outpatient clinics, riverfront recreation, and a historic downtown arts district. Housing costs are low relative to the national ZHVI, but the nearest VA medical center is outside the city.
